report.description: Gladly is a customer service platform that offers a publicly documented REST API for customers, conversations, agents, tasks, and knowledge base content. Tokens are generated in account settings and used for HTTP Basic Authentication, with optional OAuth for installable apps.

evidence.claim: Gladly offers a publicly documented REST API, earning an A on Supergood's API Report Card.
Gladly API is a RESTful service with an OpenAPI specification.
API tokens are generated in account settings and used as HTTP Basic Auth passwords, indicating user-level token access.
Setting up Gladly integration requires admin access in Gladly.
Gladly offers SDKs, sample apps, and a testing environment to support integration development.
